title: Tuya Cloudless — Searvvahit Vehkiid
error_https_required_body: Web Bluetooth HTTPS-bajisin sáhttá. Dát searvvahangoddi rahpasuvvá Home Assistant-bajisin, mii galgá leat ráhkaduvvon HTTPS:ain. Jos leat boahtán siidii njuolga HTTP:a bokte, dábistit HTTPS Home Assistantas vuosttaš.
error_browser_body: Web Bluetooth dárbbašugoahtá Chrome dahje Edge Windows dahje Android-sis. Safari ja Firefox eai doarjo Web Bluetooth.
qr_body: Web Bluetooth dárbbašugoahtá Chrome dahje Edge. Skan QR-koda Android-telefovnnain rahpat siidu doppe.
qr_unavail: QR-govva ii leat oažžumis. Sáddejit: pip install 'tuya-cloudless[qr]'
qr_copy_label: Dahje kopiere dán URL ja rahpa Chrome / Edge-s:
step2_hint: Biddje Tuya-vehki páranessemodas (nullastit dahje doallit pára-boalu gitta meroštallan njuolggui tseahkát), de čuojahat 'Ohca & Searvvahit'.
step3_ha_flow: Home Assistant mearrašugoahtá du vehki. Sáhtát giddet dán láse ja joatkit Home Assistant UI-s.
err_no_ble: ❌ Web Bluetooth ii leat oažžumis. Anu Chrome dahje Edge.
step1_desc: Vehki searvvahuvvo dán fierpmái páranahttinvuođa maŋŋel.
error_browser_unsupported_body: Web Bluetooth requires Chrome or Edge (desktop or Android). Please open this page in Chrome or Edge.
device_panel_desc: Devices found nearby appear automatically. Or use Bluetooth to scan.
no_devices_auto_found: No Tuya devices found nearby. Use Bluetooth below, or put the device in pairing mode and try again.
wifi_ap_error: WiFi AP pairing failed. Check that the device is in pairing mode and try again.
